probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not harm the viability of the embryos; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.
